Definition: apparently from the same as G4651 (through the idea of penetrating); to dissipate, i.e. (figuratively) put to flight, waste, be liberal:--disperse abroad, scatter (abroad).
BiblicalUsage: Skorpizo means to scatter, to disperse, and it is used for the generous and the faithless alike. The righteous man has dispersed abroad and given to the poor, the disciples were scattered every man to his own and left Jesus alone, and He says whoever gathers not with Him scatters abroad.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe scattering is the test of gathering, because the man who disperses to the poor gathers righteousness, and the man who will not gather with Christ scatters everything.
